The '''Alui sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered [[Quess sector/Legends|Quess]], [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell]], [[Iskin sector/Legends|Iskin]] and [[Ryndellian sector/Legends|Ryndellian sectors]] in the Mid Rim, and [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
